core: T cell receptor signaling and activation
qualifier: activation-induced cell death and alloresponse
name: T cell activation signaling and activation-induced cell death
rationale: All members concern activated T cells (TCR signaling modules, allograft rejection, Fas-regulated activation-induced death), distinguishing the theme from death-receptor apoptosis confusables that lack T cell signaling and from T helper/Treg differentiation confusables that lack AICD.

qualifier: receptor-mediated attachment and endocytic uptake
name: Viral attachment, receptor-mediated entry and intracellular transport
rationale: Members describe virion attachment, receptor-mediated endocytic entry and transport of viruses (dengue, RSV, influenza), separating the theme from confusables centred on viral protein maturation, cell-cell fusion or host suppression of infection.

qualifier: progenitor proliferation, survival and growth control
name: Kidney development growth control via progenitor proliferation and survival
rationale: Members regulate kidney and ureteric/nephric duct development through proliferation, mesenchymal progenitor maintenance and apoptosis suppression, unlike confusables focused on ureteric bud branching, mesenchymal-epithelial differentiation or intermediate mesoderm formation.

qualifier: stress granule dynamics
name: Misfolded protein aggregate clearance and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members cover aggrephagy, aggresome assembly, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy and misfolded protein responses, and uniquely include stress granule assembly, localization and disassembly absent from the ERAD/pexophagy confusables.

qualifier: norepinephrine transporter uptake
name: Norepinephrine transporter-mediated catecholamine uptake
rationale: All members concern monoamine/catecholamine transport with norepinephrine uptake and SLC6A2 defects, distinguishing it from confusables built on the dopamine transporter SLC6A3, dopamine synthesis and synaptic vesicle loading.

qualifier: osteoblast and mesenchymal progenitor expansion with mineralization
name: Osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and bone mineralization control
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation/differentiation and bone mineralization (with Wnt signaling), separating the theme from osteoclast/resorption confusables and from chondrocyte- and RUNX2-centred skeletal development confusables.

qualifier: circulating monocyte and neutrophil signatures with degranulation
name: Blood monocyte and neutrophil activation with degranulation
rationale: Members are monocyte, neutrophil and myeloid transcription modules plus neutrophil degranulation and inflammatory response, distinguishing them from confusables built on tissue macrophage, respiratory burst, formyl peptide or Fc receptor programs.

qualifier: lysine mono/dimethylation and demethylation
name: Histone and non-histone lysine methylation and demethylation
rationale: Members cover histone lysine methyltransferases and demethylases, KMT2/WDR5 complexes, lysine and arginine methylation including p53 methylation, and DNA methylation, whereas confusables emphasise PRC2 silencing, imprinting or chromatin remodelers.

qualifier: ERBB2 and EGFR mutants and inhibitor resistance
name: Oncogenic ERBB2 and EGFR mutant signaling and drug resistance
rationale: Every member concerns constitutive signaling or drug resistance of cancer-associated ERBB2 or EGFR variants, distinguishing the theme from FGFR/PDGFR/ALK oncogenic mutant confusables and from wild-type ERBB adaptor signaling.

qualifier: polyadenylation and transcript stabilization
name: mRNA polyadenylation, stabilization and decay control
rationale: Members span mRNA 3'-end cleavage and polyadenylation, decapping and decay and their inhibition, IGF2BP/CRD stabilization and export, unlike confusables centred on ARE- and miRNA-mediated destabilization or histone mRNA processing.

qualifier: heme oxygenase regulation and ferroptosis
name: Metal ion oxidative stress, heme oxygenase and ferroptosis
rationale: Members are responses to cobalt, lead, mercury, selenium and iron together with BACH1/HMOX1 regulation, peroxide metabolism and ferroptosis, distinguishing the theme from cadmium detoxification, iron import and MTF1/metallothionein confusables.

qualifier: efflux and limitation of storage and foam cell formation
name: Cellular cholesterol efflux and foam cell prevention
rationale: Members promote cholesterol efflux and lipoprotein transport, limit cholesterol storage and foam cell differentiation (including LXR targets), unlike confusables on LDL receptor uptake, SREBP-driven synthesis or HDL particle assembly.

qualifier: phase II conjugation by methylation, acetylation and sulfonation
name: Phase II xenobiotic conjugation by methylation, acetylation, sulfonation
rationale: Members cover xenobiotic and toxin catabolism through methylation (TPMT, azathioprine), acetylation and cytosolic sulfonation, whereas confusables are cytochrome P450/FMO oxidative phase I reactions.

qualifier: glutamate, glutamine and aspartate with ammonium handling
name: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen and ammonium metabolism
rationale: Members concern glutamate, glutamine, aspartate/asparagine and arginine/citrulline metabolism with nitrogen utilization and ammonium homeostasis, separating them from proline/glyoxylate, alanine/gluconeogenesis, urea cycle disorder and malate-aspartate shuttle confusables.

qualifier: antiviral restriction and translational repression
name: Nucleotide deamination editing, antiviral restriction and translation repression
rationale: Members cover ADAR A-to-I and APOBEC C-to-U editing, APOBEC3G restriction of HIV and translational repression/frameshifting, distinguishing the theme from DNA demethylation/alkylation repair, retroviral integration and coronavirus replication confusables.

name: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor-resistant ALK mutants
rationale: Every member is an ALK mutant resistant to a specific ALK inhibitor, distinguishing the theme from KIT/PDGFR resistance and FGFR/PDGFR/LTK oncogenic signaling confusables.

core: Vascular and blood cell adhesion signatures
qualifier: endothelial, perivascular and platelet adhesion-cytoskeletal programs
name: Endothelial, perivascular and platelet adhesion gene signatures
rationale: Most members are endothelial, perivascular stromal and platelet/myeloid adhesion and cytoskeletal modules (plus endothelial-matrix and cadherin adhesion, with glucocorticoid and B-cell modules as outliers), unlike confusables centred on smooth muscle/shear stress, SREBF motifs or fibroblast stroma.

qualifier: acetylation, glutamylation, folding and microtubule severing
name: Tubulin folding, acetylation, glutamylation and microtubule severing
rationale: Members concern tubulin folding, acetylation/deacetylation, polyglutamylation and C-terminal modification and microtubule severing/depolymerization, distinguishing it from histone acetylation, cilia/sperm axoneme and general CCT chaperonin confusables.

qualifier: ribbon disassembly/reassembly and intra-Golgi COPI traffic
name: Golgi ribbon disassembly, reassembly and intra-Golgi COPI traffic
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly, reassembly and positioning together with intra-Golgi and COPI retrograde/anterograde traffic, whereas confusables emphasise vesicle budding, membrane tubulation or Golgi-to-ER retrieval alone.

qualifier: COPI budding and vesicle targeting
name: COPI vesicle budding and ER-Golgi vesicle targeting
rationale: Members describe vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi and COPI vesicle budding for retrograde traffic, distinguishing the theme from vesicle tethering and COPII ER-export confusables.

qualifier: glandular epithelial differentiation and acinus morphogenesis
name: Prostate glandular epithelial differentiation and acinus morphogenesis
rationale: All members concern prostate gland growth, acinus morphogenesis and glandular epithelial differentiation, separating the theme from salivary, mammary and pancreatic gland development confusables.

qualifier: thymocyte proliferation and survival with B-lineage differentiation
name: Thymocyte proliferation and survival with early B-lineage differentiation
rationale: Members regulate immature thymocyte proliferation, survival and differentiation together with pro-B/B cell and hematopoietic progenitor differentiation, unlike bone marrow niche, thymic selection and mature T cell activation confusables.

qualifier: recombination, synapsis and checkpoint control
name: Meiotic prophase I recombination, synapsis and checkpoint control
rationale: Members cover meiotic double-strand break formation and repair, recombination, synaptonemal complex and telomere attachment, and meiotic checkpoints, distinguishing them from confusables on meiotic cohesion, chromosome segregation and spermatogenesis.

qualifier: peroxisomal phytanate alpha-oxidation
name: Fatty acid catabolism with peroxisomal phytanate alpha-oxidation
rationale: Members concern short-, medium- and long-chain fatty acid and organic acid catabolism with phytanate alpha-oxidation and pristanoyl-CoA beta-oxidation, unlike confusables centred on mitochondrial beta-oxidation steps, carnitine, ketone bodies and branched-chain amino acid disorders.

qualifier: downstream FRS2, SHC, PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades
name: FGFR downstream FRS2, SHC, PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR1-4 adaptor-mediated PI3K, phospholipase C, SHC and FRS cascades with Klotho co-receptor binding, distinguishing them from confusables on FGFR isoform ligand binding, point mutants and feedback regulation.
